props.text: We make brands ready for the round you haven't raised yet.
Quattro Studio partners with seed-to-Series-B founders on the work that comes before the next deck — positioning, identity, product surface, and the language a board can actually quote.
We work with seed-to-Series-B founders. That's the line.

Quattro is a four-partner studio working with venture-backed companies between their seed and Series-B rounds — the stretch of life where the brand stops being a placeholder and starts being a position.
We take on six to eight engagements a year. Each one runs eight to fourteen weeks. We do not take on work where we cannot meet the founder in the first week.
Brand strategy, identity systems, product surface, and the founder-facing language that holds the whole thing together. One team. One room. One bill.

content.heading: Positioning
content.subheading: Seed to Series-B. Six to eight clients a year. No exceptions.

props.title: Medical wearable rebrand · 2024
props.challenge: A continuous glucose monitor company carrying a name and identity inherited from its R&D phase — clinical, anonymous, and impossible to defend in front of a hospital procurement committee.
props.solution: A new wordmark drawn against the curvature of the device itself, a calmer two-color clinical palette, and a brand voice that reads like a trusted physician — not a startup.
props.outcome: Closed Series-B at a 3.2x step-up. Now the default CGM in three U.S. hospital networks. Procurement decks now run twelve pages instead of forty.

props.title: B2B coffee infrastructure · 2024
props.challenge: A green-coffee logistics platform whose customers were operations directors at roasters — yet the brand looked like a third-wave cafe. Buyers were not converting because they did not believe the company could carry a six-figure contract.
props.solution: Industrial-grade identity. Spec-sheet typography. Photography of pallets and warehouses, not latte art. A new sales surface that opens with throughput, not provenance.
props.outcome: Average contract value up 64% in two quarters. Cycle time on enterprise deals down from 11 weeks to 6. Now powering green-coffee flow for four of the top twenty U.S. roasters.

props.title: SaaS reporting tool · 2023
props.challenge: A finance reporting tool built by ex-Stripe engineers, sitting on $4M ARR and a brand their CFO buyers found 'too clever.' The product was excellent. The first impression was not.
props.solution: A reset toward institutional confidence: a serif wordmark, a single accent color, a product surface re-centered on the report itself. The marketing site now opens with a real rendered statement, not an illustration.
props.outcome: Pipeline conversion up 41%. Sales cycle to enterprise CFOs cut nearly in half. The product is now the default reporting layer at three publicly-traded brand portfolios.
props.metrics: +41% pipeline conversion · 47% shorter cycle · 3 public-co clients
